description: Card 20261115-b-234610: a seat with its own `nexus_slots > 0` shows the capacity-report line `workers N/<cap>, nexus M/<nexus_slots>` rather than one merged open count -- and the worker count excludes a busy Nexus pane dispatched under the same seat, the same exclusion `commands::dispatch`'s `is_nexus_role` already applies. A seat capped at 2, hosting one busy Nexus pane and one busy worker pane, reads `workers 1/2, nexus 1/1` (STATE available, not at cap) -- not the pre-fix `open: 2/2` (STATE at cap: 2/2 open agents), which counted the Nexus pane as a worker. `accounts-open-agent-cap` (nexus_slots unset, no Nexus pane) still pins the old merged `⛁ open: N/cap` text byte for byte.
